content: Hi! How can I help you today? Are you ready to share your latest design assets, or do you need help organizing them for your client?
Hi! I'm trying to send my logo and brand guide files, but the folder link I created isn't working for my client. Any ideas?

No worries, this happens sometimes! Could you double-check the folder's sharing settings? For privacy, set it to 'view only.' If you like, you can copy a fresh share link and send it to your client again.
I just updated the permissions to view-only and sent a new link. Should I keep all versions of the logo in one folder?

That's a great idea! I recommend creating a folder called 'Logo_Versions' and naming each file like 'Logo_v1.ai', 'Logo_v2.png', etc. This way, your client can easily browse and download whichever version they need.
Perfect, I've organized them as you suggested. What about the brand guide PDFs and font files?

Wonderful job! For clarity, make separate folders: 'Brand Guide' and 'Fonts.' Upload each PDF and font file to its respective folder. Then your client can quickly click through each section and download the originals.
All files are uploaded now. Is there anything else I should do before letting my client know?

You're doing great! I'd suggest adding a brief 'Read Me' note in the main folder to explain the structure. Then, invite your client to visit the shared folder, browse the materials, and download any files they need.
Good idea, I've added a Read Me file. Should I mention anything about privacy or copyright?

Absolutely! A friendly reminder in your note for the client to use the assets only for the agreed project is always helpful. Also, it's considerate to avoid including any files with sensitive metadata or personal info.
Thanks, I'll include that in the note. Can I ask the client to let me know if any files don't open?
Definitely! Encourage your client to click into each folder and try downloading the files. If anything doesn't work or they need a different format, you can quickly re-upload or adjust permissions.
I'll send them the link with these instructions now. Appreciate your help!
You're very welcome! Let me know if you run into any more bumps. Wishing you smooth sharing, and I'm sure your client will love the organized delivery!
